title: Decoupling Distance and Networks: Hybrid Graph Attention-Geostatistical Methods for Spatio-temporal Risk Mapping
abstract: arXiv:2603.08393v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate spatial prediction and rigorous uncertainty quantification are central to modern spatial epidemiology and environmental risk analysis. We introduce a statistically principled hybrid modelling framework that integrates the nonlinear, attention-based representation learning capabilities of a dynamic Graph Attention Network (GATv2) with a latent Gaussian spatial process from model-based geostatistics (MBG). This framework jointly captures relational dependence encoded in graph structures and continuous spatial dependence governed by physical proximity. We evaluate the proposed model via a controlled simulation study and an applied analysis of malaria prevalence data, comparing its predictive accuracy, calibration, and uncertainty quantification against classical geostatistical models and standalone GATv2 architectures. translated_title: 解耦距离与网络：用于时空风险制图的图注意力-地统计学混合方法
translated_abstract: 精确的空间预测与严格的不确定性量化是现代空间流行病学和环境风险分析的核心。我们提出了一种具有统计学原理依据的混合建模框架，将动态图注意力网络（GATv2）基于注意力的非线性表示学习能力，与基于模型的地统计学（MBG）中的潜在高斯空间过程相融合。该框架能够联合捕捉图结构中编码的关系依赖性，以及由物理邻近性支配的连续空间依赖性。我们通过受控模拟研究和疟疾流行数据的实际分析对该模型进行评估，并将其预测精度、校准性能和不确定性量化与经典地统计学模型及独立的GATv2架构进行比较。我们的分析表明，GATv2能够捕捉复杂的非线性交互作用，但无法充分刻画残余空间依赖性，而所提出的混合框架则有效弥补了这一缺陷。
tldr: 该研究提出一种将动态图注意力网络（GATv2）与基于模型的地统计学潜在高斯空间过程相结合的混合建模框架，可同时捕捉图结构中的关系依赖性与物理距离驱动的空间依赖性，从而在时空风险制图中实现更优的预测精度和不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid framework that couples a dynamic Graph Attention Network (GATv2) with a model-based geostatistical latent Gaussian spatial process, jointly capturing graph-encoded relational dependence and proximity-driven spatial dependence to achieve superior predictive accuracy and uncertainty quantification in spatio-temporal risk mapping.
